retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast 1980s pop aesthetic featuring a central subject within a geometric, multi-colored architectural set framed by a dark, patterned border.
triggerTerms: pastel architectural backdrop with industrial accents

recipe.visualDefinition: A studio portrait set within a complex, candy-colored architectural environment. The scene is characterized by flat geometric planes, cylindrical columns with terrazzo-like patterns, and flexible metallic industrial ducting. This central image is inset within a dark, textured border that features organic, camouflage-like shapes and bold horizontal color bars.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject seated on a low geometric platform as the central focal point
Juxtaposition of soft pastel walls against rigid primary-colored blocks
Contrast between organic border patterns and the sharp lines of the inner set
Repetition of cylindrical forms in both the columns and the metallic pipes
coreInvariants: Asymmetric framing with a thick dark border
Memphis-inspired color palette (pink, blue, yellow, red)
Presence of industrial metallic textures (flexible ducting)

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is medium-scale, positioned in the lower-left quadrant of the inner frame, seated on a platform.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright yellow vertical pillar on the right and the large pink wall provide structural stability.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the subject to the metallic pipes on the right, then up to the top-right typographic lockup, and finally down to the bottom horizontal text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark outer border acts as a heavy frame, compressing the vibrant inner scene.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Primary blue and yellow geometric accents
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the geometric elements against a low-value dark background.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to 80s pop primaries and pastels

letterConstructionRules: Extreme vertical elongation for secondary text
Italicized, heavy-weight block letters for primary display
Integration of horizontal rules and color bars into the type lockup
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'J' features an extended descender that acts as a graphic underline
The letter 'i' uses a diamond-shaped tittle
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy italicized display type paired with ultra-thin, vertically elongated secondary type.

candidateDirections.reason: For the heavy, condensed top display text
For the ultra-condensed, tall bottom text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio photo of a person in a white blazer sitting on a terrazzo-patterned block. The background is a Memphis-style set with pink walls, a yellow pillar, and silver flexible industrial pipes. Frame this image within a dark charcoal border featuring abstract organic patterns and bold horizontal color bars.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a heavy, red italicized sans-serif font in the top right corner, integrated with blue and yellow horizontal lines. Add ultra-condensed, tall white sans-serif text across the bottom, spaced widely.

verificationChecks: Is the subject framed by a dark, patterned border?
Are there metallic flexible pipes in the scene?
Is the typography vertically elongated at the bottom?
Does the color palette include pink, yellow, and blue?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject

avoid: Natural textures like wood or grass

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the pipes have a realistic metallic sheen
Check that the text does not touch the subject
Verify the terrazzo pattern is consistent across platforms
Confirm the border pattern is abstract and not recognizable camouflage
recipe.reuseFormula: Memphis Set Design + Industrial Accents + High-Contrast Graphic Border + Vertically Elongated Typography
